Indian Stocks Plummet Amid Global Oil Price Drop

The Indian stock market experienced a significant decline on [date] due to the drop in global oil prices. The Sensex and Nifty indices fell by 1,677.12 points and 516.65 points, respectively. This move is attributed to the recent announcement by US President Donald Trump regarding the reduction of tariffs on imported goods. The impact of this decision has been felt across various sectors, including energy and finance.
